mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE course_id = #{courseId}

SELECT c.id, c.content, c.user_id, u.username AS user_name, u.avatar AS user_avatar, c.course_id, c.created_time FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY c.created_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (course_id, user_id, rating, content, created_time) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{userId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{createdTime})
